summary: Verified mobile (390x844) and desktop label visibility fix on /admin/nakit-akisi 'Yeni Hareket' dialog. All 6 labels render with slate-900 (rgb(15,23,42)), 14px, font-weight 600 on both viewports. End-to-end submission (Gelir/Nakit/250/today/'Test kapora'/'mobile test') successfully posted to /api/transactions (200), toast 'Kaydedildi' displayed, dialog closed, new row appears in table with correct values, and summary stats (Bugün/Bu Hafta/Bu Ay) updated to ₺250.

issues: Minor: Vazgeç (Cancel) button in DialogFooter appears cut off below Kaydet on mobile viewport due to footer stacking — not a blocker but worth checking flex-direction/gap on footer for 390px width.
Console warns: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from ResponsiveContainer on initial mount — cosmetic, not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminTransactions.jsx dialog form label fix implemented correctly with 'text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 mb-1 block' on all 6 labels; placeholders added on inputs/textarea — matches request exactly.
Consider stacking DialogFooter buttons on mobile (flex-col sm:flex-row) so Vazgeç does not visually collide with Kaydet on 390px width.
ResponsiveContainer initial render warning is a known recharts quirk; could suppress by adding minHeight/minWidth to the wrapping card content on very small viewports.

If retesting, use Radix Select via page.get_by_role('option', name='...').click(force=True) — plain text=Nakit matches sidebar nav item first. rca of the issue: Original labels used 'text-xs' with no explicit text color, inheriting a very light default from a parent — barely visible on iOS mobile. Fix applied to all 6 form labels ('Tür', 'Ödeme Yöntemi', 'Tutar (₺)', 'Tarih', 'Kategori', 'Açıklama') now uses text-sm (14px), font-semibold (600), text-slate-900 (rgb(15,23,42)), mb-1 block — verified via getComputedStyle on both viewports.
